source.body:
<!-- branch-audit:start -->
## Current development audit - October 24, 2026

**Status:** status:paused  
**Inspected branch:** **main** at 873d3569ee6bcb9efb827f930cb6d0c40c84db47

Supplier proposal policy and implementation remain paused; this audit creates no resumption or procurement authorization.

This issue remains open. Branch implementation is not main integration, full V5 acceptance or a LIVE-source qualification.

- [Inspected source](https://github.com/gbw30/PantryPulse/blob/873d3569ee6bcb9efb827f930cb6d0c40c84db47/docs/pantrypulse/SPEC-V5.md)

Fresh audit checks: main 642 non-integration/non-worker tests and 89 PostgreSQL queue/migration/supervisor tests; VP 159 focused tests and 38 PostgreSQL migration/stock tests; or_pipeline 104 optimization/native/CLI tests and 40 PostgreSQL persistence/HTTP tests. All passed in isolated containers. Browser, Linux cgroup/OOM/descendant and full-gate results in old task packets are historical evidence, not rerun by this audit.

Cross-branch integration is tracked in #67 (database/audit/worker convergence) and #68 (expiry/lot semantics). No source branch was merged, no hosted migration/deployment was performed, and supplier/Chronos pauses remain.

This audit supersedes older readiness wording below while preserving scope and history.
<!-- branch-audit:end -->
## Outcome

Resolve and implement simulated supplier proposal scope when resumed.

**Backlog ID:** PP-61  
**Suggested lane:** Supplier / paused scope (suggestion, not an assignee or exclusive path claim)  
**Readiness:** PAUSED - explicit resumption required

## Development prerequisites — blocked by

- [ ] https://github.com/gbw30/PantryPulse/issues/8 — PP-30: Freeze operational identity, history, receipt and ledger contracts
- [ ] https://github.com/gbw30/PantryPulse/issues/11 — PP-33: Freeze operational scenario, FEFO and shared feasibility contracts
- [ ] https://github.com/gbw30/PantryPulse/issues/23 — PP-39: Implement dated FEFO inventory and shortage projection
- [ ] https://github.com/gbw30/PantryPulse/issues/31 — PP-47: Integrate sequential allocation/comparison jobs and checked publication
- [ ] https://github.com/gbw30/PantryPulse/issues/33 — PP-49: Implement presenter authorization and thin same-origin Next.js proxy

## Additional gate

PAUSED: requires explicit user resumption and reviewed unresolved supplier policy before development.

## Scope and deliverables

- Keep OPEN-03/26–28 paused until explicit resumption; then resolve split sourcing, offer terms, coverage, currency/budget periods, limits, ranking and lifecycle.
- After reviewed policy, implement seeded/manual offers and coordinated draft baskets covering only after ETA within available forecast dates.
- Account for confirmed stock/arrivals and selected transfer plan; preserve alternatives/uncovered need and treat method baskets as alternatives under one budget.
- Keep unapproved proposals outside physical/confirmed inventory and primary comparison; no supplier messages, orders, payments or dispatch.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] After-arrival coverage cannot erase earlier lost sales; shared budget/per-order constraints hold across beneficiaries.
- [ ] Repeated generation/cancel and alternatives follow final immutable proposal policy with no stock or external side effects.
- [ ] V5-A14 remains blocked until completed or explicit scope amendment; creating this issue does not resume paused work.

## Source and implementation boundary

V5 §11; BD-22–24; OPEN-03/26–28; V5-A14. [Authoritative V5](https://github.com/gbw30/PantryPulse/blob/main/docs/pantrypulse/SPEC-V5.md).

Planning source checkout: `04df41ced650896bd4f4a4cd10de1354b406d216`, October 24, 2026. The newer local `docs/pantrypulse/WORKER-JOB-QUEUE-SPEC.md` v0.1 is a technical proposal, not an amendment to V5; its GitHub default-branch copy was not available at planning time. Review/freeze relevant proposals before durable/public implementation. Dataset research is advisory. Existing completed primitives #1–6 must be reused where applicable.

Before assignment, record exact base SHA, owned paths, contract/fixture versions and acceptance commands in a bounded task packet. Lead serializes migrations, shared schemas/config, generated types and locks. Preserve unrelated work and active worktrees. Evidence must identify commands, tree/runtime/dataset and limitations; mocked/pure checks cannot prove database, process, model or solver integration. This issue does not authorize deployment, submission, real dispatch/payment or resumption of paused model/hosting/supplier work.
